text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Just before the start of the Japanese<n>Oaks, Mejiro
Dober asks me if I<n>believe in her strength.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I reaffirm my wholehearted belief in<n>her. She
accepts my answer and<n>leaves for the course!
